question: Why did our webhook stop working?

model.source: recorded from openai/gpt-oss-120b through the openai provider

replies.text: Your webhook `wh_31c9` was automatically disabled after it hit a long streak of failures (50 consecutive time‑outs) and was marked as “disabled” on 2026‑09‑30 [obs:2]. When a webhook repeatedly fails to deliver its POST requests, Fernway disables it to prevent further issues. You’ll need to re‑enable it (or create a new one) once the endpoint is fixed. [help:webhooks@2#0]
